rationale: The image alt "Red Panda" exactly repeats the link text "Red Panda" in the same link, so the words are read twice; alt="" would lose nothing.
The fallback text "Alternative text" is a placeholder that says nothing about what the object embeds, and its computed name is empty; no other description is reachable.
Text "AU Video" (a heading-styled div) sits immediately before the video and names it, which is enough to identify time-based media.
An h2 "AU Video" directly precedes the video in the same section, identifying it for screen reader users.
